summary: This bill directs the Attorney General to establish a competitive grant program to help state, territorial, local, and tribal governments hire, retain, and train prosecutors and support staff, with a federal share not exceeding 75% of project costs.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a grant program to help states, territories, and local governments hire, retain, and train prosecutors and their support staff. By increasing the number of prosecutors, the bill aims to strengthen the prosecution side of the criminal justice system, which aligns with a stricter justice approach.
